title: Does pid's cells plot still show anything on reversed decoys?
body:
## What exists today

`pid parse cells` writes `cells.true.tbl` and `cells.decoy.tbl`, nail's cell fraction against the query by target cell count. `plot_cell_frac.py` draws them into `figures/cells.pdf`. The decoys have been reversed TrEMBL sequences since `f12fda4`.

## The change

Check the data behind the cells plot on the reversed decoys. Jack thinks the plot lost its punch with reversals and no longer shows anything interesting.
